name: Osama Farouk
title: DevOps Engineer
availability: Available for Select Roles / Freelance Consulting
summary: DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with 5+ years of experience supporting enterprise platforms and production environments. Skilled in building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, deploying containerized applications, and automating infrastructure. With a strong focus on deployment reliability, observability, automation, and operational stability.
aboutStoryParagraph1: Over the past 5+ years, I have built my career across infrastructure operations, application support, and DevOps engineering, working with complex enterprise systems in both on-premises and cloud environments. This background has given me a practical understanding of the complete service lifecycle—from infrastructure and incident resolution to CI/CD, container orchestration, automation, and observability.
aboutStoryParagraph2: My approach combines operational discipline with continuous improvement. I collaborate with development, support, and infrastructure teams to simplify deployments, troubleshoot complex issues, reduce manual effort, and improve system reliability. I enjoy transforming repeatable operational work into automated, maintainable solutions while continuing to expand my cloud and platform engineering expertise.
